questions.q: Find the magnitude of the column vector (5 over −12).
OA = a and OB = b. Find AB.
OA = a, OB = b and P lies on AB with AP : PB = 1 : 3. Find AP.
questions.why: AP is 1 part out of 1 + 3 = 4, so AP = ¼AB = ¼(b − a).

questions.q: PQ = 2a − b and PR = 6a − 3b. What does this show about P, Q and R? Give a reason.
questions.model: PR = 3(2a − b) = 3PQ, so PQ and PR are parallel and share the point P, so P, Q and R are collinear
